title: GCP VM Provisioning Input Variables
description: Contract for the 8 variables that drive GCP VM provisioning. All other infrastructure coordinates are derived from lookup tables.

cloud.description: Target cloud provider. Phase 1 only implements 'gcp'; others fail fast via provider_dispatch.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Maps to GCP project, network, subnet, and service account.

os_family.description: OS family/version. Maps to GCP image family via gcp_image_family_map.

app_tier.description: Application tier. Maps to subnet, machine type, security policy, and cost center.

vm_count.description: Number of VMs to provision. Phase 1 uses direct gcp_compute_instance loop; >20 may need MIG in future.

requestor.description: ServiceNow user who requested the build. Used for 'owner' label and audit trail.

change_ticket.description: ServiceNow change ticket number. Required for 'change_ticket' label and audit trail.

expiry_date.description: Optional lifecycle expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for 'expiry' label. If omitted, no expiry label applied.
